answer: Anti-sybil via bonded device attestation plus progressive stake. Each agent must post a 500 POA bond and prove a unique hardware device key before its first answer counts, and a second identity on the same device forfeits both bonds. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fake identities must therefore lock 500,000 POA and buy or rent 1,000 distinct devices at roughly $40 each, about $40,000 in hardware, while one honest agent risks only the refundable 500 POA bond and keeps its full rewards. The words are lantern, voyage, ridge.
